entry.title: The crisis of civilization and Penty's vision of the rebirth of guilds
entry.summary: In his analysis, Artur J. Penty points out that the contemporary civilizational crisis stems not only from economic errors but also from a profound decline in spiritual and moral values. Industrialization and machine production have led to the alienation of labor and chaos that is destroying the social fabric. Penty advocates for a return to a model of moral economy based on craft tradition and professional ethics. His vision involves decentralization and a fight against consumer tyranny by improving the quality of production. The text provides an in-depth analysis of the confrontation between capitalism and craft ethics, pointing to the Arts and Crafts Movement as an inspiration for future systemic change. It is a call to reclaim spirituality in business and build a more just socio-economic order.

entry.summary: You write a .mdc rule. It looks fine. Cursor ignores it completely.
